title_en: A Cloud Is Swirling, the Eagles Screech
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Note says this is a version of 'Песна за Караџата'. 'Спици се прават' read as skewers/spikes used for torture, my reading; 'усти затворат' read as 'mouths are shut' (dialect).

lines.en: A cloud is swirling, the eagles screech,
the Balkans sing the dreadful song,

lines.cyr: Дали врни, грми ил' се земја тресе,
lines.lat: Dali vrni, grmi il' se zemja trese,
lines.en: Is it raining, thundering, or is the earth shaking,

lines.cyr: Или се борја од корен корнат?
lines.lat: Ili se borja od koren kornat?
lines.en: Or are the pines being torn up by the roots?

lines.cyr: Ниту врни, грми, нит' се земја тресе,
lines.lat: Nitu vrni, grmi, nit' se zemja trese,
lines.en: It is neither raining nor thundering, nor is the earth shaking,

lines.cyr: Ниту се борја од корен корнат.
lines.lat: Nitu se borja od koren kornat.
lines.en: Nor are the pines being torn up by the roots.

lines.cyr: Буки се сечат, спици се прават,
lines.lat: Buki se sečat, spici se pravat,
lines.en: Beech trees are cut, skewers are made,
and set under the fingernails of Macedonians.

lines.cyr: Фурни се горат, железа се топат,
lines.lat: Furni se gorat, železa se topat,
lines.en: Ovens are burning, iron is melting,
and the mouths of Macedonians are shut.

lines.cyr: Дали има уште, кој да не знае,
lines.lat: Dali ima ušte, koj da ne znae,
lines.en: Is there still anyone who does not know

lines.cyr: Има ли уште, кој да не знае,
lines.lat: Ima li ušte, koj da ne znae,
lines.en: Is there still anyone who does not know
the Gevgelija field, all the way to Salonica,
